Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible 1st class electrical contractor/Supplyers/Repoted Bonafied firm as mentioned below
as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet (TDS) as well as Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the electro--mechanical works shall be five (05) years.
b) The minimum specific experience of the Contractor(s) at least 01 (One) contract of Supply and Installation of Generator
successfully completed within the last five (5) years with a value of Tk.60.00 (Taka Sixty) Lac only. Government/ Semi-
Government/ Autonomous Bodies within Bangladesh.
c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk.70.00 (Taka Seventy)
Lac only.
d) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC category Contractor & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing
Board.
e) The Tenderer must have up to date Income Tax clearance Certificate from the NBR with TIN up- to- date.
f) The Tenderer must have up-to-date VAT Registration Certificate.
g) The Tenderer must have up- to- date valid Trade License .
